name: Ramen Spice Girls
source: 4 years have passed since Afterglow disbanded. Tomoe, Himari and Ako formed a new band. The Udagawas, who also play in a band,  are very supportive of their daughters. Tomoe and her mother Athena looks back into what brought them here
translation: Afterglow解散已经过去4年了。巴、希玛丽和亚子组成了一支新乐队。宇田川夫妇也在乐队中演奏，他们非常支持他们的女儿。巴和她的母亲雅典娜回顾是什么让他们来到这里
